terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.introduction: Before continuing, review the conditions that apply to this reservation. The current version will be linked to your acceptance.

objeto.title: 1. Purpose and acceptance
paragraphs: These terms and conditions govern access to the RentaMóvil platform and the reservation and rental of vehicles through it. Checking the authorization box, together with the date, version and data of the selected reservation, constitutes digital evidence of acceptance of this document.
The customer declares that they have read and fully understood them. If they disagree with any of its provisions, they must not continue with the reservation or make the payment.

requisitos.title: 2. Customer requirements
paragraphs: The customer declares that they meet the minimum age required by applicable regulations, hold a valid driving licence for the entire rental period, and have the legal capacity to accept these terms. The platform does not request or verify driving documents.

At pickup the customer must present, at the branch, their identity document, licence and any other requirements communicated. The reservation holder is responsible for the vehicle during the rental; the platform does not manage additional drivers. Providing false, expired or insufficient information may prevent the vehicle from being handed over, without prejudice to the customer's rights.

reserva.title: 3. Selection, availability and price
paragraphs: The reservation represents a request subject to verification of availability, data, chosen coverage and payment. RentaMóvil may offer an equivalent vehicle of the same category when necessary, disclosing any price difference and obtaining the customer's approval when the change substantially affects what was contracted.

The total shown on the platform corresponds to the products, dates, branches, coverage and services selected. Included taxes are expressly identified on the payment screen. Tolls, parking, fines, consumption and other third-party charges will be paid by the customer when required by law or by the service provided.

pago.title: 4. Payment, receipt and reservation activation
paragraphs: Payment must be made exclusively through the enabled and current channels and bank accounts shown on the platform. The customer must transfer the stated amount and submit a legible receipt that can be linked to the reservation.

Submitting the receipt does not equal payment approval nor does it confirm the reservation by itself. The status remains pending review until an administrator validates the transfer. A rejected payment, an incorrect reference, an amount mismatch or an illegible receipt will not activate the service. The receipt must not be shared with third parties outside the authorized channels.

cambios.title: 5. Changes, cancellation and refunds
paragraphs: Once a reservation is created it cannot be cancelled from the platform, and the vehicle, pickup date and return date cannot be changed. Only the return branch can be changed, while more than 3 days remain before the return date and the reservation status allows it.
An approved payment is not refundable at the customer's request. The exceptions are cases where RentaMóvil cannot provide the service (section 11) and the inalienable consumer rights provided by law.

entrega.title: 6. Vehicle handover
paragraphs: Handover takes place at the confirmed branch, date and time slot, subject to availability and timely presentation of the required documents. The customer must receive and inspect the vehicle before leaving the branch.

The handover includes a check of appearance, mileage, fuel, accessories and basic operation, the result of which is recorded in the handover document. Any damage, missing item or defect not recorded must be reported before driving off.

deposito.title: 7. Guarantees and third-party payments
paragraphs: The platform does not charge or manage security deposits. If a branch requires an additional guarantee, it will be communicated before pickup and handled outside the platform, and it is not part of the reservation payment.

Damages, fines or other amounts attributable to the customer will be claimed in accordance with the law, with prior notice and respecting the customer's right to dispute them. The platform does not process these charges.

uso.title: 8. Permitted use and prohibitions
paragraphs: The vehicle may only be used for lawful travel by the authorized driver. Prohibited uses include, among others, driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs, racing, competitions, speed trials, off-road driving, overloading, unauthorized commercial use, subletting, abandoning the vehicle, removing or tampering with the GPS device, and any unlawful activity.

The driver must comply with traffic regulations, signage, circulation restrictions and legitimate orders from the authorities. The customer will be liable for the consequences of improper use, without prejudice to the contracted coverage.

responsabilidad.title: 9. Liability, incidents and insurance
paragraphs: The customer must drive carefully and immediately notify RentaMóvil, the competent authority and, where applicable, their insurer of any accident, theft, damage or incident. They must not carry out repairs or move the vehicle without authorization, except for an urgent measure to prevent further damage.

The customer will be liable for fines, tolls, parking fees, and damages or losses to third parties to the extent legally applicable. The chosen insurance coverage operates only within its scope, limits and deductible; it does not replace uncovered liabilities. The summary of the selected coverage is part of the reservation.

devolucion.title: 10. Return
paragraphs: The vehicle must be returned to the stated branch, date and time, with the same fuel level, mileage, accessories, documents and quality condition, except for permitted ordinary wear. The return will be documented through an inspection and handover record.

The return date and time of the reservation are fixed: they cannot be changed or extended from the platform. A late return does not produce an automatic extension. A late return, or one made outside the agreed branch, may generate additional charges as communicated by the branch.

disponibilidad.title: 11. Availability and force majeure events
paragraphs: RentaMóvil may modify or cancel a reservation for reasons of safety, maintenance, lack of availability or other justified cause, notifying the customer. In that case, the refund of amounts corresponding to services not rendered will be handled in accordance with the law and what the customer has already used.

Force majeure events, civil unrest, traffic restrictions, emergencies or other circumstances beyond reasonable control may alter dates, routes or conditions. The customer must use the official channels to receive instructions and options.

datos.title: 12. Personal data and communications
paragraphs: The data provided will be used to manage the reservation, verify the payment, provide support, comply with legal obligations, prevent fraud and maintain the security of the platform. Processing will be carried out in accordance with data protection regulations and the privacy notices and purposes that RentaMóvil will disclose to the customer.

Operational communications — for example, reminders, payment status and delivery instructions — may be sent through the registered channels. Commercial use of the data or marketing communications require the separate authorization required by law.

derechos.title: 13. Intellectual property and limits of liability
paragraphs: The platform, its design, texts, logos, photographs and other components are used exclusively to facilitate the service. The customer may not reproduce, modify or commercially exploit them without prior authorization.

To the extent permitted by law, RentaMóvil is not liable for indirect damages or loss of profit arising from the use of the platform. This limitation does not exclude liabilities that cannot be excluded, nor the consumer's rights. The customer must use the service lawfully and responsibly.

vigencia.title: 14. Validity, applicable law and contact
paragraphs: This version applies to reservations initiated from its publication date. Changes will be published with a new version and date; the version accepted by each customer will be kept together with the evidence of acceptance. Modifications affecting vested rights will not be applied to an already accepted reservation without express authorization or legal basis.

This relationship is governed by Colombian law. Any dispute will be resolved through the applicable dispute resolution mechanisms and by the competent courts and tribunals, without prejudice to consumer protection rules. For inquiries, the customer may use the official channels published on the platform or go to the branch related to the reservation.
